protectedCapacity: floor(3 * allocated_resident_slots / 4); zero and one slots have zero protected capacity
admission: Every completely decoded resident is published probationary.
promotion: A second successful resident pin promotes probationary entries. If protected capacity is full, demote the protected resident with the smallest existing last_used, with slot order breaking ties. Demotion can include pinned entries and changes no pin or liveness state.
victim: Smallest (protected, last_used, slot_index) among unpinned, occupied, unselected slots; probationary sorts before protected.
staging: Fallible hit preparation is read-only and precharges every retention mutation. A mode-specific by-value HitPlan is committed only beside the existing infallible final pin publication. Miss planning changes no retention metadata; publication precharges the new resident tier reset.
privateHooks: CacheMode::resident_victim with literal original LRU default and Swift-only override
accounting: SwiftSlot metadata is included in size_of<SwiftSlot> before its existing allocation. Mode-specific plan/helper/return objects receive disjoint conservative operation inventories. Extra metadata reads and writes receive CacheWork credits before use or mutation. Extra fixed bytes reduce payload inside unchanged budgets.
finiteMatrix: hot functions with one-use scan longer than resident capacity versus actual baseline LRU
equal ages and order-preserving age rebase
every hit/miss work prefix and cancellation boundary
allocation preadmission, payload reduction, exact work, cleanup
limitation: Cumulative attribution does not identify hot functions or prove this policy benefits the actual Swift workload. An independent review and separately selected full diagnostic remain necessary.
